messages:
Anika P.: quick flag: v3-canary of the fncall/schema validator is surfacing ~2.7% validation_failed and routing those calls to a fallback, which is inflating token counts.
Rob C.: do we have a sample failure to triage?
Anika P.: minimal excerpt from canary logs: ```tool_response: "{\"result\": \"[]\"}" -> expected object for 'result' but got string```
Soo J.: product concern: users see extra consumption and support tickets. Billing: we can't silently write off retries without a contract.
billing-bot: Billing can honor a marker header `X-Validation-Outcome: soft-warning` to zero out retry attribution but requires RFC + backfill rules.
Rob C.: telemetry gap: we only surface fallback counts. proposal: emit `validation.v3.reject_rate` gauge and dimension `reason=[type_mismatch, missing_field, malformed_json]`. add trace tag `validation.mode=strict|lenient`.
Anika P.: UX: show a small "Schema warning" badge on invocations and a sampled link to raw payload (PII-scrubbed). admin toggle: "Treat validation failures as warnings".
Soo J.: rollout plan: (1) metrics + sampling only, (2) add console badge, (3) soft-warning routing for 1% traffic, (4) expand to 10% if stable after 48h, (5) enable billing header after billing sign-off.
Rob C.: sampling: canary=100% capture (scrub PII), prod default 0.5% per-reason, store in s3 with hashed user_id.
Anika P.: pushed tiny PR to emit the reason enum + header: https://git.internal/r/redwood/validator/pulls/565
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for validator v3-canary on eng-platform (slice: beta). :rocket:
Anika P.: set alert: pause canary if validation.v3.reject_rate > 3% for 10m.
deploy-bot: Alert fired (validation.v3.reject_rate = 3.4%), canary paused automatically. ref: alert#val-2026.
Soo J.: agreed to roll back, lower strictness threshold, and reconvene with billing + support. I will open the RFC for the header contract.
Anika P.: assigning owners: Anika (validator), Rob (telemetry), Billing team. Thanks everyone :heart:
